anya: Heads up — users hitting the onboarding sample app on Android 12 see repeated SocketTimeoutException after the first request. On Android 13 devices it's fine. Stack shows okhttp3.internal.http2.StreamResetException sometimes. Anyone seen this with our SDK?

sam: hmm. Are you using the sample app's default OkHttpClient from the repo or a custom client/interceptor? @liam

anya: sample app + our auth interceptor. Repro steps: open app, tap 'fetch models', sometimes returns, sometimes times out. Happens on wifi and emulator too. Logs show 'timeout on read' then 'stream was reset: CANCEL'.

liam: Could be our retry wrapper + non-idempotent requests. If the Authenticator retries the same request with a streaming body it can fail. Did you set `retryOnConnectionFailure(true)`?

anya: yes, `retryOnConnectionFailure` is true. Auth flow uses `Authenticator` to attach a fresh token. I also noticed we set `readTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)` in the sample to avoid streaming cutoffs — maybe that's causing weirdness on older Android versions.

sam: `readTimeout(0)` means infinite — some Android network stacks behave poorly with infinite reads. Try an explicit finite timeout (e.g., 2m). Also make sure the client isn't recreated per call. Quick patch I tested locally: 

```
OkHttpClient client = new OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .connectTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .readTimeout(2, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .authenticator(myAuthenticator)
  .build();
```

liam: And double-check we're not recreating the client for each request in the sample. That leaks connections and can trigger stream resets on older platforms — use a singleton OkHttpClient.

anya: Tried finite read timeout + singleton client + temporarily disabled `retryOnConnectionFailure` -> stable on emulator and Pixel 4a (Android 12). Looks like a combination of infinite read timeout + auth retry + client-per-request was the trigger. I'll open a PR to change the sample defaults and update onboarding notes.

deploy-bot: Created issue #2314: "sample-app: okhttp readTimeout + retry defaults cause intermittent SocketTimeoutException on Android 12" https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/issues/2314

sam: Nice. Add a troubleshooting blurb about `Authenticator` replays and non-idempotent bodies, and call out `readTimeout(0)` as discouraged on Android. :thumbsup:

anya: Will do — PR up shortly, thanks everyone. :rocket:
